title: Battlepack section 69 — Movies

container.notes: Section 69 of battle_pack.bin (71-section battlepack: u32 count, count+1 u32 file offsets incl. an unpadded end offset, sections 16-byte aligned with zero fill; see container-battlepack). The section is an st2e table: 32-byte header (magic, u32 entryCount @4, u16 entrySize @8 = 8, u32 entryListOffset @12 = 32, u32 textSectionOffset @20 = 0) followed by entryCount packed 8-byte entries and zero padding to a multiple of 16 bytes (see container-st2e).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'st2e' (73 74 32 65); reject the section if different.

fields.name: entrySize
fields.notes: Bytes per entry; 8 (0x8) for this section.

fields.name: entryListOffset
fields.notes: Offset of entry 0 from the section start: 32 when entryCount > 0, else 0.

fields.name: offset10
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

fields.name: textSectionOffset
fields.notes: Inline text offset; 0 on disk for this section (filled at run time). No strings are stored here.

fields.name: offset18
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output for this section).

fields.name: offset1C
fields.notes: Unknown offset slot (0 in Workshop output).

records.name: movie
records.where: st2e entries of section 69: header.entryListOffset + i*8

fields.name: unknown00
fields.notes: Not read; kept as zero by the Workshop.

fields.name: fadeInFrameTimeStart
fields.notes: Frame at which the fade-in starts.

fields.name: fadeInFrameTimeDuration
fields.notes: Length of the fade-in in frames.

fields.name: fadeOutFrameTimeStart
fields.notes: Frame at which the fade-out starts, counted backwards from the end of the movie.

fields.name: fadeOutFrameTimeDuration
fields.notes: Length of the fade-out in frames (counted backwards).

fields.name: unknown05
fields.notes: Not interpreted here. The Workshop READER takes the fade colour from byte 5 (low 2 bits) while its WRITER stores it in byte 7; see gaps.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Fade colours. Position follows the Workshop writer and the Lua Loader docs.

roundTrip: Edit fields in place; the record size is fixed and nothing in this section points at entries, so value edits never move data.

Copy every byte that no field interprets (unknown*/padding, unnamed bits) from the original; the Workshop writer zero-fills them (it seeks over them), so do not use its output as the byte-identical reference.
Keep the st2e header bytes verbatim except entryCount (and entryListOffset when the count goes to/from 0).
Keep the trailing zero padding that rounds the section to a multiple of 16 bytes.
If the section length changes (added/removed entries), rewrite the battlepack offset table: every later section offset and the end offset shift by the padded size delta.
flags (0x07): change only bits 0-1; preserve bits 2-7 and bytes 5-6.
gaps: Fade colour location: byte 7 (Workshop writer, Lua Loader) vs. byte 5 (Workshop reader). Verify on vanilla data.
Meaning of byte 0 and the movie-id mapping of rows.
Frame units (game frames vs. movie frames).
